failure_summary.description: Returned an overlong or overly descriptive form instead of the shortest answer (e.g., added a middle initial, organization type, or extra alternatives).
Selected a related but wrong entity by missing the requested answer slot or failing to match all clue details.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly requires concise canonical answers, exact slot matching, and verification against the full clue. These failures are best explained by not following those rules; adding another broad reminder would duplicate existing guidance.
